travel_grants.name: Graduate Travel Fellowship
travel_grants.eligibility: Post-baccalaureate students in CSULB master's, doctoral, credential, or graduate certificate program presenting at a conference
travel_grants.frequency: Once per student annually; priority to first-time applicants; first-come basis
travel_grants.open_to: All students including international, undocumented, and DACA students

travel_grants.name: ASI Student Travel Fund
travel_grants.eligibility: Graduate students presenting research at conferences

travel_grants.name: Student Life and Development (SLD) Travel Grant

fellowships_and_scholarships.name: Sally Casanova Pre-Doctoral Scholars Program
fellowships_and_scholarships.purpose: Help CSU students explore and prepare for doctoral programs; enhance faculty diversity.
fellowships_and_scholarships.additional_benefit: Fully-funded summer research experience at UC campuses or major research universities (for those not yet in PhD program).
eligibility: Upper-division undergraduate or master's student at a CSU campus
Assigned a faculty mentor (tenured or tenure-track)
U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or DACA recipient

fellowships_and_scholarships.name: Graduate Equity Fellowship (GEF)
fellowships_and_scholarships.purpose: Support master's and doctoral students who contribute to diversity or equity.
fellowships_and_scholarships.process: Must be nominated by a faculty member; contact your graduate advisor for procedures and deadlines.

fellowships_and_scholarships.name: State University Grant (SUG)
fellowships_and_scholarships.eligibility: California residents or AB 540-eligible students demonstrating financial need
fellowships_and_scholarships.how_to_apply: Automatically considered when submitting FAFSA or California Dream Act (CADA) application

fellowships_and_scholarships.name: Chancellor's Doctoral Incentive Program (CDIP)
fellowships_and_scholarships.purpose: For doctoral students who aspire to become CSU instructional faculty.

employment.name: Teaching Associate (TA) and Graduate Assistant (GA) Positions
employment.description: Available through academic departments across all 7 colleges.
employment.how_to_find: Check individual college listings; contact your department.

employment.name: Federal Work Study
employment.description: Federally funded employment for students with greatest financial need.
employment.how_to_apply: Through Financial Aid and Scholarships Office

employment.name: CareerLink
employment.description: CSULB online resource listing full-time, part-time, federal work study, and internship positions.
employment.access: Through Single Sign-On portal (free for all students)

financial_aid_office.description: Official hub for scholarship information; administers external and university scholarships.
